objects.title: Melo snails and the story of Melo pearls

editorial.short_summary: Snails are not only a great ingredient for many seafood dishes, but they are also associated with the anecdote of the extremely rare Melo pearl. However, you should distinguish these two things: feel free to call the snail because of its taste, but don't be mistaken for the fact that every snail on the tray hides a gem inside.
editorial.practical: Consider the snail as simply a delicacy to enjoy, while the story of hunting for Melo pearls should only be considered as an anecdote. When ordering, you only need to pay attention to what kind of food the restaurant prepares, what the portion is and what the price is. Even if you hear the rumors about the chance to find the pearl, just enjoy your meal in the most realistic way.
editorial.expectation_vs_reality: The American Institute of Gemology (GIA) once recorded the Melo snail species around Phu Quoc Island and affirmed that their pearls are extremely rare, even considering the large number of individuals. Therefore, you don't just call the snail plate that you are seizing the opportunity to win a pearl. Daily food and precious pearls are two completely different concepts in two completely different worlds.
before_you_go: Clarify the type of snails, weight, price and quantity of the portion.
Don't spend money on snails just because of the false promise of finding the Melo gem.
If you intend to buy high-value items, it is mandatory to have independent inspection documents.
People with shellfish allergies need to avoid food as well as common processing utensils absolutely.

Why is the rate of finding Melo pearls so low compared to the amount of snails caught for food?

editorial.short_summary: Bánh tét mật cật is distinguished by the narrow palm leaves used to wrap it and its triangular cross-section. Slices reveal fragrant glutinous rice around a rich filling. When buying it as a gift, check the packing date and storage advice.

If you have to travel far, you should only buy a sufficient amount to ensure that the cake does not spoil along the way.

As for the filling, the plasticity of the sticky rice or the aroma of the leaves bears the unique imprint of each baker. Check the production date and expiration date of the cake.
Follow the instructions for refrigeration if you haven't eaten it right away.
Buy a moderate amount if the accommodation does not have a refrigerator for storage.

Do bánh tét mật cật only appear on holidays or are they a daily dish all year round?

Each place will have its own recipe that creates different sweetness, astringency and alcohol content. Anyway, this is still an alcoholic beverage, so don't use it expecting it to have a healing effect.

To choose a satisfactory gift, ask carefully about the ingredients, how to store it and whether the product has been fermented or not.

Instead of just guessing the taste by name, reading the label will help you make a more accurate choice.

editorial.short_summary: The journey of a bottle of famous Phu Quoc fish sauce begins with a batch of fresh anchovies, salty salt grains and months of fermentation in wooden barrels. This traditional profession has been protected by geographical indications. When buying, read the label carefully, carefully look at the origin instead of just focusing on the protein number.
editorial.practical: To buy authentic Phu Quoc fish sauce, observe the place of production, ingredients and geographical indication stamps printed on the bottle. Protein content is a good factor to refer to, but whether that bottle of fish sauce is suitable for raw dipping or seasoning depends on the saltiness, aroma and unique taste of your family. If you have the opportunity, don't hesitate to taste it before buying in bulk.
editorial.expectation_vs_reality: Two bottles of fish sauce with the same protein content may not bring the same feeling on the tip of the tongue. The difference lies in the secret of fermentation, aroma and aftertaste, while geographical indications have their own strict regulations on origin. Don't be mistaken for thinking that just having the word 'Phu Quoc' on the label means that the product has met protection standards.
before_you_go: Read the label carefully and verify the origin information.
If allowed, try the smell and taste before deciding to buy a large-capacity bottle.
Ask the store how to pack it safely to bring on board.
Clearly distinguish between products printed with Phu Quoc characters and products with real geographical indication certificates.
curiosity_questions: What is the mystery hidden behind the fact that Phu Quoc barrel houses always use giant wooden crates?
What core values of a bottle of fish sauce is Phu Quoc actually protecting?

editorial.short_summary: Inside a fish sauce barrel house, the rows of huge wooden barrels make it much easier to understand why traditional fish sauce takes time, care and patient work. If staff are available, ask about the fish-to-salt ratio, how the ferment is managed and when the first-draw sauce is collected.
editorial.practical:
A barrel-house visit is much more useful with an explanation than as a quick walk past wooden barrels. Ask how the anchovies are salted, how the ferment is monitored and how long a batch rests before sauce is drawn off. Remember that this is still a working production site: use the visitor route and ask before photographing people at work.

Do not visit only to buy a bottle
The most interesting part is the scale of the craft. Large wooden barrels, pipes, the smell of fermentation, the ageing mixture and the way producers talk about anchovies, salt and time turn an everyday condiment into something rooted in a specific place.
If there is a designated visitor route, follow it. Do not open lids, touch barrels or walk into production areas without permission. This is a working food-production site, not a full exhibition space.
editorial.expectation_vs_reality:
Every producer presents the experience differently. Some barrel houses feel very industrial and strongly smell of fermentation; others have more polished visitor or retail areas. Floors can be damp and production areas may be restricted, so do not open barrels or enter work zones without permission.

If you want to understand more, ask about ingredients and how the sauce is drawn
Every producer has its own scale, fermentation time and grading system. Do not stop at 'how many degrees of nitrogen is this?'. Ask whether the nitrogen level is natural or after blending, whether it is first-draw fish sauce or a blended line, and how the fish and salt are handled.
Also separate facts about one producer from facts about the Phu Quoc fish-sauce tradition as a whole. Barrel count, factory size and fermentation time should always be attributed to the specific barrel house they describe.
before_you_go: Contact the producer in advance to confirm whether visitors are accepted and which production areas can be seen.
Wear non-slip footwear; barrel-house floors can be damp.
Do not touch equipment or taste anything unless staff invite you to.
If buying bottles to take away, ask about origin, sealing and packing for transport.

Because each stall has a time frame, the sooner you go, the more privileges you will have.

objects.title: Cano, passenger speedboat or ferry: what's the difference?

editorial.short_summary: Let's take to heart the function of this trio: canoes are often used for tours to visit small islands, high-speed boats mainly carry passengers across the sea between the mainland and Phu Quoc, and ferries have a large capacity to carry passengers, cars, motorbikes and goods. Some high-speed boats can also pick up motorbikes or goods according to the regulations of each company and each trip, so if you bring a vehicle, you must ask the right carrier before booking.
editorial.practical: Whenever you call to ask about the situation of the train or want to close a ticket, be clear about which route, what day and what type of vehicle you are using. A day of rough seas that causes a canoe tour to the island to take a break does not mean that the high-speed boat or ferry must also be on the shore, as the operating conditions of each type are different. If you are bringing a motorbike or sending goods, ask the shipping line or ferry directly about the availability, documents, hours of availability, and transportation limits. If you are carrying a car, you should choose a pick-up ferry.
editorial.expectation_vs_reality: Using only one generic word "train" is very misleading. Canoes in An Thoi usually serve island tours; high-speed boats mainly carry passengers between Ha Tien/Rach Gia and Phu Quoc, but some trips may carry additional motorbikes or cargo; ferries have larger vehicle compartments and are suitable for cars. The schedule or license of one type of vehicle does not guarantee that the other will also depart on the same day.
before_you_go: Clearly confirm that you are buying a canoe ticket for an island tour, speedboat or ferry.
Double-check the departure station, route, departure date and time.
If you are bringing a motorbike or sending goods, ask the right airline if the trip is acceptable; if you are carrying a car, choose a ferry that picks up the car.
Follow notifications from the airline or call center close to the date of travel.

objects.title: From the airport to Duong Dong

editorial.short_summary: From the baggage carousel of the International Airport back to the center of Duong Dong, you have a whole basket of choices from waving a traditional taxi, booking a technology car to surf the application, renting a private car to pick you up at the door to reclining on the hotel's convenient transfer car. The vital key here is that you have to throw the driver an accurate accommodation address to each small alley, because Duong Dong is a huge "monster" in terms of area; with just a generic area name, two hotels can be located at both ends of the tropics that are annoyingly far apart from each other.
editorial.practical: If the hotel where you are staying offers an airport shuttle service, be wise to ask in advance if they charge any additional fees, which door the pick-up point is closed, and how to identify the driver in the middle of a sea of people. In case you choose to open a ride-hailing application, strain your eyes to check and compare the license plate carefully and patiently walk to the exact parking position that the airport management has planned. The fact that the countdown clock tells the time to roll from the airport to Duong Dong is also manipulated by dozens of external factors such as the address of the corner, the density of traffic jams and the time you are tired of waiting for the carousel to release your luggage; Therefore, please never set the next dining or entertainment appointments too close to each other.
editorial.expectation_vs_reality: Let's immediately remove the prejudice that Duong Dong is just a small "parking lot" with a single drop-off coordinates; in fact, it is a busy central urban area and stretches for a long time. Even two hotels at the same time register the address 'Duong Dong' on the booking confirmation, but in real life they can be located far away from each other, a taxi is quite expensive. The estimated travel time displayed on the map application is still just a spectacular deception if you haven't accumulated the whole amount of time standing and yawning waiting for luggage, the time spent wandering around looking for the booked car, or the misfortune of being entangled in a road jammed with passers-by at dusk.
before_you_go: Shoot accurate coordinates: Send the full name and specific address of the hotel, instead of just typing two superficial Duong Dong letters.
Confirm by text or phone directly with the shuttle department if your flight is "delayed" to land at dawn or late at night.
Obediently read and follow the modern lane signage outside the airport lobby.
If you still have a lot of plans to "shake" the schedule right after landing, smart calculate and deduct some free time for waiting for luggage loading and unloading and calling a car.

objects.title: From the airport to An Thoi and Sunset Town

before_you_go: Deliver an accurate positioning "like a nail in a pillar": the destination you want to go to is the hotel gate, the anchorage harbor, the cable car station or the stage where the art show takes place.

Make a plan to call a car to escape to the hotel if the entertainment program lasts longer and ends after midnight.
Immediately extinguish the reckless thought of wanting to match the schedule of the late landing time of the plane with the opening bell of the performances too closely.

objects.title: From the airport to the North Island

editorial.short_summary: From the airport, making a triple trip back to the North Island is known as the longest "carry-on" route compared to pulling over in the central area, especially if your hotel is located in the Ganh Dau area or hidden in remote isolated resorts. You have the freedom to choose to call a traditional taxi, book a private car in advance, use the resort's special shuttle service or take an affordable public bus route; but remember to keep in mind the problem of accumulating the whole journey from the bus stop to the hotel door.
editorial.practical: In the journey from the airport to the North Island, the first and most important step is to use a compass to clearly determine whether the final destination you need is the glittering Grand World supercomplex, the wild Safari zoo or the fence gate of a specific resort. If you are a backpacker and plan to use public bus services, it is imperative to find out which stop is closest to your destination and whether the last bus of the day is still leisurely starting to pick you up after the plane lands. In unfortunate scenarios such as a flight landing in the dark, a mountain of cunning luggage or crying children attached, the option of picking up the engine in front of a private car will usually help you master the initiative; Don't forget to check carefully with the hotel about the additional fees incurred as well as agree on a specific pick-up location.
editorial.expectation_vs_reality: Although the modern VinBus system has implemented a route along the North Island, it is absolutely not a promise that the big bus will pull over straight into the lobby of every resort along the way. Because route planning, driving times and parking stops can be adjusted suddenly, keeping up with information updates from official media channels as the departure date approaches is a survival skill that cannot be ignored.

It is necessary to calculate and deduct the entire walking journey from the bus point to the lobby of the accommodation area.

objects.title: Getting between Duong Dong and An Thoi

editorial.short_summary: The journey from the capital of Duong Dong down to An Thoi and then turning back is actually not a short stroll back and forth between two check-in points as many people mistakenly believe. If your day's plan involves canoeing to the island, riding the cable car or enjoying art shows in the evening, the wisest thing to do is to pick up and gather all the "tasks" in the South Island area into a seamless schedule; this will help you solve the problem of saving a bunch of useless time that is burned on the way.
editorial.practical: As long as you have a strong desire to appear in An Thoi at the time of the train pulling anchor or the opening time of the theater, the survival formula is to lock down the mandatory time to be present at the destination, then calculate the subtraction for the time required to manipulate the ride, rubber on the road due to traffic jams, waste time struggling to find a parking lot and wading sweaty to the door. The solution to choosing a taxi or booking a contract car is always a safe move, it is easier to control the time and route; and the decision to ride a motorbike across the island should only be pressed the "Start" button when you are confident that you have enough silk steering skills and are too connoisseur to memorize each concave ramp. And remember, if the art show ends in the dark, you must have the diplomatic skills to arrange a shuttle bus back long ago.
editorial.expectation_vs_reality: If you just throw a glimpse on the 2D map screen, the Duong Dong - An Thoi route seems like a straight and smooth road, but the price you have to pay for the excitement of going back and forth many times a day will drain a large amount of your vitality and precious time. Moreover, the entrance to the fishing boat harbor areas, winding towns and the Sunset Town virtual living complex is completely located on different vertical and vertical crossing roads, so you must practice the habit of using addresses with very detailed and specific coordinates so as not to get lost.
before_you_go: Plan a strategy to combine the scattered attractions in the South Island into a full day of ploughing if the schedule time frame allows.
Secure a detailed address and the exact name of the port you need to set foot in.
Generously allow some time to find a motorbike parking lot and walk apart before entering the departure time of the tour or the time of the show.
If the schedule lasts until dark, you must absolutely have a plan to call a car back to the backup.
curiosity_questions: What scattered attractions in the South Island should be collected and assembled into a cluster by tourism "wise men" to avoid the tragedy of losing hours just because they have to drive around many times?

objects.title: Getting between Duong Dong and Ganh Dau

editorial.short_summary: Taking a trip back to Ganh Dau from the navel of the center of Duong Dong, you can completely cleverly combine a few hot spots in the North Island such as Safari Zoo, VinWonders Park or the city that never sleeps Grand World into the same route. Although they are obediently located in the same compass direction, you still have to bend yourself to pay the price with tiring travel times and have to queue up at completely independent ticket gates; Therefore, the truth here is that you don't have to just see the dots on the map to be able to race in time to do everything in one day.
editorial.practical: Planning to sweep the North Island, the first guideline is to prioritize choosing a "nail" gathering that you aspire to take root and spend the most youth time, then smoothly push the boat to combine the rest of the attractions conveniently scattered on the same road. Playing the system of riding a private car or waving a taxi will be extremely smooth and convenient when you constantly need to stop unexpectedly in many places; on the contrary, the VinBus ride plan is only really "suitable" if the parking stops and bus times happen to match perfectly with the schedule that you have already winded. And please, if you want to go straight to a romantic beach or a certain lemongrass resort gate, you are required to type the name of that place verbatim, but you absolutely cannot just enter the two curse words 'Ganh Dau' into the navigation system.
editorial.expectation_vs_reality: The territory of the North Island is much larger than the illusions that deceive the eye when you just stare at the gathering points that seem to be close to each other on the virtual map application. There will be torturous roads that require you to call an extra tank hoe to connect, tired of standing in line with dragons and snakes to buy tickets, or having to spend time coaxing the children to pull over and rest in the middle of the trip. The public bus system is also absolutely not designed to obediently transport you to the lobby of every accommodation address, so please don't get into the habit of calculating the driving time just by guessing by the name of a vast area.
before_you_go: Create a habit of storing the specific address and details of each attraction instead of just making a sloppy note of the two words Ganh Dau.
Spend 5 minutes surfing and looking up information about the route, running route and timetable of VinBus applied closely for that day.
Make a diagram of a cluster of amusement parks located close to each other to avoid the trap of having to carry the body and turn the car around many times ungracefully.
Tired of staying to watch late-night music and dance shows, smart plan to book a shuttle bus home before nightfall.
curiosity_questions: What geographical mystery created the paradox: it was obviously located on the same tray in the North Island, but some of the coordinates were stretched apart for a long distance from each other?

objects.title: Getting between Duong Dong and Rach Vem

editorial.short_summary: The adventurous backpacking route connecting from the center of Duong Dong to Rach Vem fishing village hides an extremely interesting unknown at the end of the red dirt road, where all levels of experience depend entirely on which beach or the coordinates of the raft house you have targeted. After the pouring rains, this naked journey will probably consume you many hours and a lot more frustration than you expected; Therefore, remember to take to heart the bloody lesson: open your mouth to ask for directions about the entrance and thoroughly investigate the muddy road surface before you dare to turn the accelerator and rush in.
editorial.practical: At the beginning of the journey to Rach Vem landing, the prerequisite is to open your mouth to ask the locals or the owner of the restaurant about an accurate address to every centimeter of the village, the coordinates of the floating raft house or a pristine stretch of coast that you are longing to visit. If in the last few days the sky has just poured rain, caution is never superfluous: probe the muddy condition of the dirt road before deciding to pull out the anchor to start, visit the filling station to fill the gas tank and click your knuckles to carefully calculate the safe time to return. For dreamy backpackers who are not used to "shaving" jagged red dirt roads driving long distances, or those who are accompanying a large family with a large family, spending a little more money to choose a car that moves more smoothly than a motorbike will probably be an extremely wise and pleasant salvation option.
editorial.expectation_vs_reality: The Google Map may be sophisticated in knowing the direction of the road, but what it can never tell you in advance is whether on that day the asphalt road will be turned into a muddy puddle or not, or if a trail will turn horizontally and vertically, whether it will still be opened for people to pass through or blocked by a barrier. Inserting a generic pin called 'Rach Vem' on the phone is also absolutely uncertain, it will guide you to the door of the seafood raft house that you have happily called to make a deposit before. The act of picking up the phone, calling the book, asking for directions to the destination before pulling the anchor away will help you save yourself from the prospect of crying badly because you have to wrestle with the winding, muddy, lost roads on the little jagged trails.
before_you_go: Work as a meteorologist: Carefully check the rainfall forecast and fairly assess the slippery conditions of the road surface on the day you plan to go.
A destination has the correct address: the name of a village, the name of a raft, or a specific beach.
Stop by the station to fill up the gas tank in a hurry before driving out of the boundaries of the busy central areas.
Keep a cool head: If you find that the dirt road in front of you is too muddy or deeply flooded, bravely squeeze the brakes to stop, pull over and ask the locals for another safer turn.
curiosity_questions: After the pouring rain like the anger of the gods, how can the unique red dirt road leading deep into Rach Vem fishing village be deformed and "deformed" harshly, making many backpackers falter?

objects.title: Getting between Duong Dong and Ham Ninh

editorial.short_summary: Departing from the center of Duong Dong and driving through the fishing village of Ham Ninh is a journey across the island going straight towards the sunrise on the east side, and if you still have plenty of time in your budget, the wise operation is that you can completely skillfully combine crossing over another attraction located in the same direction. However, while waiting for your arrival, please do not naively use photos of the old rickety wooden bridge as a landmark to trace the navigation route; instead, it is essential that you call to confirm in detail the name of the restaurant, the pier or the actual sandy beach that you are planning to visit and rest.
editorial.practical: During the pilgrimage back to Ham Ninh, send a message to locate the exact name of the seafood restaurant, anchorage or deserted beach that you need to visit the body. If you are cooking up a romantic intention to drive to catch the first rays of the sunrise, take to heart a harsh truth: the distance you drive away at the start of everything around you is still engulfed in dense darkness, so it requires the driver not only to be familiar with controlling the car but also to be bold to drive safely in the dark. The decision to get into a comfortable air-conditioned taxi, book a private car or drive a motorbike to tear the wind depends entirely on the physical fitness of the companion and the time you are expected to turn around.
editorial.expectation_vs_reality: Ham Ninh stretches a vast coastal area, not a magical dot with magic to guide you to every corner of the hidden place in the heart of this village. The old wooden wharf that used to make rain and wind appear in many poetic wedding photos has now been dismantled and changed for flesh, so please don't foolishly cling to using that "antique" photo as a guiding lighthouse to search for the trail that goes down to the coast at the present time.
before_you_go: Sharp positioning: Determine the correct one hundred percent of the specific address clearly before deciding to pull out the phone to call a ride.

Warning to go to work "paparazzi" to welcome the sunrise: it is mandatory to carefully calculate the route of the road in low light conditions, the sky and the earth are still as dark as a jar of buttons.
Make an outline of combining amusement spots with the same orientation to save energy, reducing the prospect of having to drive separately for each stage.

Comply with the rules of the fishing village: It is not allowed to blatantly drive directly into the dead-end passages of residential areas or enter piers when people are sweating at work if you have never had permission from anyone.
curiosity_questions: The experience of riding a motorbike along the island passing from Duong Dong ice to Ham Ninh fishing village will open up in front of your eyes the contrasting scenery of the two sides of the West - East of the island, how different is heaven and earth?

editorial.short_summary: The public bus system is likened to tiny arteries that help perfectly connect a number of residential clusters, airport lobbies and busy tourist gathering points in Phu Quoc; However, it is absolutely not a miraculous royal carriage to take tourists to the lobby of every nook and crannial hotel or every deserted beach. Before carrying your backpack, be alert to see which route the bus runs which way, accurately locate the station point that must go up and down and check the schedule of the day's trips; then calculate adding the torture time for the last stretch of the road if you find that you still have to sweat walking or waving another motorbike taxi to reach the destination.
editorial.practical: If you decide to give your full trust to modern VinBus buses, it is imperative to carefully review and check the information about routes 17, 19 and 20 displayed on the company's official social media channels right before the trip. Take the time to carefully check the engine start time, locate the rest stops and the regulations on ticket purchase conditions of the exact route you are longing to take. On days when you are stuck with a fixed flight schedule that cannot be moved or holding in your hand tickets to see shows with dead hours, the golden advice is to always have a backup plan in mind to call another taxi, in case the "dumbbell" shines down and causes the bus to be stuck in traffic late, not matching your schedule.
editorial.expectation_vs_reality: The harsh truth is that having a busy bus route passing through an urban area doesn't automatically mean that a bus stop will automatically pop up right next to your beloved hotel or dream attraction. Bus schedules, pick-up and drop-off stations, and bus fare subsidies are also things that can be adjusted and changed at any time. And please, don't naively assume in your mind that any bus that takes you out on the island is completely free just because you accidentally hear the crowd rumors, passing on such vague information.
before_you_go: Review the information at the root: Look up all information on the route and departure time posted directly from the bus company's website before carrying the body to wait at the station.
Check Google Maps carefully: Click to measure carefully how far you have to walk from the bus stop to the final destination.

Have a plan B: If your amusement plan requires the exact rigor of punctuality, remember to leave a generous amount of spare time or, preferably, save the number of a taxi station that has a replacement car for peace of mind.
Stop the illusion: Never give your entire life to your schedule just to rely on three photos of old car schedules posted by someone online.
curiosity_questions: In the spider web map, which VinBus routes are holding the most powerful key in connecting the smoothest and most convenient journey from the noisy airport lobby to the monumental entertainment complexes on the North Island?

editorial.short_summary: Short rides around the center are often as easy as turning your hand when you can wave a taxi or call a technology car. But if you are thinking of traveling across the island, traveling to remote areas or looking for a car at the end of the night, everything needs to be prepared more carefully. Agreeing in advance on the price, waiting time of the driver, and the route back are the secret to a smooth trip.
editorial.practical: Around Duong Dong, you just carelessly surf the ride-hailing application. But whenever you intend to travel from South to North, catch a flight at dawn or need a car to be on duty through many stops, clearly agree in advance on the amount, waiting time and return plan. When the car is waiting for you to arrive, don't rush to step on; glance at the license plate, confirm the driver's name and compare the appointment location on the app to make sure you don't get on the wrong car.
editorial.expectation_vs_reality: Having an app on your phone does not mean that you always click on a driver to pick up the pickup, especially in remote areas or at peak hours when customers are pouring into the street. A pickup that requires a stop at many stations will have a different way of calculating the fare than running a circuit to the destination. Comparing fares is only really meaningful when you have clarified all the surcharges for waiting time and pick-up points.
before_you_go: Pin down exactly every millimeter of pick-up and drop-off points.
Frankly ask the price and accompanying conditions if the car has to wait in many places.
Once you have traveled far from the center, you must always calculate the back route to call a car back.
Absolutely do not step on cars with license plates or drivers that do not match the information on the application.
curiosity_questions: What is the mystery that makes the same distance displayed on the application but the waiting time for the car to arrive is a huge difference between areas in Phu Quoc?

editorial.short_summary: Renting a motorbike brings a sense of absolute freedom for you to pull over in every corner of the island, but be careful, the roads from North to South are much longer and more exhausting than you think. You should only nod your head to receive the car when you have a valid driver's license in Vietnam, are familiar with unfamiliar roads and carefully examine the condition of the car, helmet as well as the terms of the contract.
editorial.practical: If you are a foreigner who plans to use an International Driver's Permit (IDP) to rent a car, check carefully whether it complies with the 1968 Vienna Convention, and it is mandatory to clip it with a valid national license in the correct class of vehicle. At the moment of receiving the car, take out your phone to take a picture of the entire situation outside, squeeze the brakes, turn on the lights, lightly kick the tires to check the tension, and always remember to wear a helmet when rolling. Once you have determined to taste a little drunken yeast of alcohol, absolutely hand over the car keys.
editorial.expectation_vs_reality: Please don't naively believe that all papers with the word 'international' printed are automatically approved by Vietnamese law. Also, don't be in a hurry to imagine that just renting a car means that you suddenly have enough "process" to handle steep or unfamiliar roads. If turning the accelerator of a motorbike is not your forte, a taxi or contract car will be a lifesaver to bring more relaxation and peace of mind to your vacation.
before_you_go: Review the type of IDP and national driver's license against the current regulations of Vietnam.
The driver's license must be in the correct class of motorcycle and certainly not expired.
Wear a decent helmet, test the brakes/lights and take proof of the vehicle's condition before receiving the handover.
Repeat the mantra: Don't drive after drinking.
curiosity_questions: What kind of international driver's license is really recognized by Vietnamese law so that you can rent a motorbike to walk around the island?

editorial.short_summary: A self-driving car gives a group of friends the privilege of mastering time, stopping wherever they want, going wherever they want. But before eagerly receiving the keys, take a few minutes of youth to carefully examine the validity of the license, insurance terms, deposit amount, current status of the car and the limits of the contract; especially foreign visitors need to overturn the regulations on the use of international driver's licenses in Vietnam.
editorial.practical: The process of renting a self-driving car requires you to present a valid national driver's license, the right class of vehicle, and an IDP that complies with the 1968 Vienna Convention in accordance with the law. When handing over the car, carefully take a picture of any scratches on the exterior, read every word about the delivery fees, insurance benefits, kilometer limits, and rescue plan if the car accidentally sits still in the middle of the road.
editorial.expectation_vs_reality: Make no mistake: the fact that the car rental owner nods to hand over the keys is no substitute for confirming your legal status when you are whistled by the traffic police. The economic problem also needs to be recalled; self-driving is not necessarily cheaper than renting a car with a driver, especially if your group has a few people, the schedule turns into difficult places with no parking, or is stuck in contracts full of fees.
before_you_go: Drag the IDP and national license to compare to see if it matches the class of car you intend to rent.
Read aloud each of the terms of insurance, deposits, mileage limits, and "penalty" fees incurred.
Take 360-degree photos or videos of the car both at the time of pickup and return as proof.
Check out the parking capacity at your hotel and the coordinates you're aiming for.
curiosity_questions: What international driver's certificates are considered legal passports for you to hold the steering wheel of a car in Vietnam?

editorial.short_summary: Locking in front of a bus from the airport will turn into a real savior if your flight lands in the middle of the night, carrying a whole bunch of concubines or carrying mountains of luggage in your armpits. Be fair and agree on the price, type of car and meeting point with the driver from the moment you are on the ground; if you take advantage of the hotel shuttle, be sure to get information about bus times and boarding conditions.
editorial.practical: Before hooking your wallet to book a shuttle, the first action is to call the hotel if they have this privilege, then take into account how many seats are based on the number of people, the number of suitcases, and the landing time. If you need a baby bassinet or a spacious box, you must shout from the moment of booking. Throw the flight code to the driver, lock the meeting location and the contact method; unlucky that the plane is delayed and changed the time, you have to turn it over and report it to people and wait.
editorial.expectation_vs_reality: Don't be under the illusion that the two words 'airport pick-up' are always a separate luxury car; it can be a shared car with a stranger, or a bus that runs according to the hotel's rigid fixed time frame. The price and time spent yawning and waiting also fluctuate depending on the nearby address, flight time and number of people. So, get rid of the default thinking that booking in advance is always cheaper than waving a taxi or hailing a technology car in the lobby.
before_you_go: Provide the correct flight code and locate the hotel address without a single mistake.
Truthfully declare the number of "lives", suitcases and request child seats if any.
Ask bluntly about prices, waiting times, and specific identification points at the airport.
The plane changed its schedule and had to "shoot the news" to update it immediately for the unit to pick up the procession.
curiosity_questions: Landing at Phu Quoc airport late in the evening, should you be wise to book a car from home or call a taxi in the lobby with your eyes closed?

objects.title: Passenger speedboats and ferries to Phu Quoc

editorial.short_summary: From Ha Tien or Rach Gia to Phu Quoc, you can take a high-speed boat or ferry. High-speed boats mainly carry passengers, but some companies/trips may accept additional motorbikes or cargo; ferries have a larger vehicle capacity and are a necessary option if you bring a car. Each airline has its own schedule and transportation pick-up regulations, so please check the exact date before booking your tickets.
editorial.practical: When booking a train or ferry ticket, double-check the departure port, docking station, departure date and time and type of vehicle. If you are bringing a motorbike, ask directly if the company will pick up the car, what are the paperwork, how long you need to be present in advance, and where to pick up the car when you arrive on the island. If you are bringing a car, you need to choose a ferry with pick-up. Close to the travel date, check the calendar and any notices of changes from the airline.
editorial.expectation_vs_reality: An old schedule photo online may not be true to the day you traveled. High-speed trains and ferries have different ways of operating, carrying capacity, and vehicle pick-up regulations; some high-speed trains can accept motorbikes, but that does not mean that every trip has room or accepts all types of vehicles. The fact that one type of vehicle is running does not guarantee that the other type will operate properly at the same time.
before_you_go: It is clear which port to go from Ha Tien or Rach Gia and which port to land in Phu Quoc.
If you are bringing a motorbike, ask the right company if the trip will pick up the car and if there is a seat; if you are bringing a car, choose the ferry that picks up the car.
Parking of cars or goods must be inquired directly with the company's customer service department.
Check the schedule and operation status in the days close to the departure time.
curiosity_questions: If you want to bring a motorbike to Phu Quoc, what information do you need to ask the company before booking a ticket?

editorial.short_summary: Hovering around in the Duong Dong area, finding an ATM to release money is often much easier to breathe than places where monkeys cough and crow far from the center. The golden advice is that if today's schedule turns to small islands or the gas station goes to the North Island for the whole day, withdraw a cash file on your back so that you don't fall into the tragedy of having to turn around and find a tired machine.
editorial.practical: If you need cash, pull out your phone and open the "Near me" function to look for nearby ATMs, but remember to strain your eyes to check the address and access to see if it is easy to go. There are machines that are located inside the transaction room, which means that you will be "banned" if you come outside office hours. Withdrawal fees, limits for a single release of money and compatibility with foreign cards are completely determined by the bank; if the machine has a smoke error, it is best to stop the operation immediately and call the card issuing bank immediately.
editorial.expectation_vs_reality: A blue-and-red pin indicating the location of the ATM on the map does not carry an oath that the machine is lit up or that the inside is full of cash. Some "guys" are very smart, resolutely refusing to chew foreign cards, not to mention the fees or exchange rates when withdrawing with international cards also dance depending on the bank. Fraudulently cheating your back with some spare cash will save you from moments of laughter and tears when you finish eating at small toad shops.
before_you_go: Withdraw just enough cash to spend before venturing into remote areas or boarding a boat for an island tour.
Spread the risk: hide money in several different safe corners, don't foolishly collect all your eggs in one basket.
Read carefully the terms of the withdrawal fee schedule of the bank that issued your card.
If the machine shows signs of swallowing the card or releasing a transaction error, do not stubbornly insert the card and try again and again.
curiosity_questions: With a long day of exploration of the North Island, when should you start taking care of cash withdrawals?

editorial.short_summary: Luxury hotels or superficial stores in Phu Quoc are often very "open" in swiping cards, but if you wander around at popular restaurants, the option of using cash or scanning a domestic QR code is on the throne. International tourists need to "wake up": seeing a sign with a big QR code does not mean that the foreign banking application in your phone can scan and pay smoothly.
editorial.practical: Before excitedly ordering food or using the service, ask the restaurant owner directly if they prioritize receiving cash, swiping the card or scanning the QR, especially when you only have one payment option in your wallet. With the QR scanning method, check if your application is familiar with the payment system in Vietnam and patiently wait for the screen to report a successful transaction. Using a foreign card, determine the spirit of previewing the foreign currency conversion fee table of your bank.
editorial.expectation_vs_reality: QR codes for domestic transfers are often quite "picky", not necessarily cooperating with all types of foreign e-wallets. Swiping a card or checking a QR code also sometimes proves a disastrous failure just because of a flickering network connection or security limitations from the bank. Having some cash on hand or having a back-up payment plan will help you solve these "stand-up" situations quickly and neatly.
before_you_go: Bring some cash change or have a spare credit card handy.
Ask the store if they accept the type of credit card you're using.
Double-check the deduction history on the app before naively swiping a second time for a faulty transaction.
Absolutely do not share a photo of the card face or OTP code with any strangers.
curiosity_questions: What is the technical mystery that makes two QR codes look the same with the naked eye, but foreign e-wallets can only make payments through the right one?

editorial.short_summary: When there is a need to exchange foreign currency in Phu Quoc, it is mandatory to go to licensed banks or exchange agents and clearly question the "cash purchase rate". The flashing exchange rate numbers on the reference list are not always the real money that you will hold in your hand, especially when you hold bills of different denominations or exchange less popular foreign currencies.
editorial.practical: When bringing cash to exchange, keep your eyes glued to the correct column "cash exchange rate", do not dream of taking out the number of the "transfer rate" column to calculate it mentally. You must ask the counter staff if they accept the foreign currency and the denomination of the bill you are holding, then ask to close the amount of Vietnamese Dong received before officially handing over the money. Count the money slowly at the counter and store the transaction receipt carefully.
editorial.expectation_vs_reality: Even if it is the same currency, the cash purchase rate, the selling rate, and the transfer purchase rate are three completely different numbers. Don't naively think that every currency exchange point will apply the same bargain price. With large sums of money, a seemingly small difference like an ant on a listing board can swell into a lost amount of money that makes you sad.
before_you_go: Choose to deposit gold at large banks or reputable and properly licensed money exchange agents.
Ask to read the applicable exchange rate and lock in the actual amount received before passing the money through the glass door slot.
Count the money fairly at the counter and keep the receipt as proof.
Stay away from the enticements of money exchange transactions from "baits" floating outside official exchange points.
curiosity_questions: What is the financial reason for the fact that the same US dollar bill is the same but when sold in cash, the exchange rate is different from if you sell it by bank transfer?

editorial.short_summary: You can find pharmacies in Duong Dong, An Thoi and around residential areas, but they are not always open or have the right medicine you are looking for. To avoid the hassle of driving, it is best to call and ask in advance. In particular, in emergency situations, run directly to the medical facility instead of just visiting the pharmacy.
editorial.practical: When visiting to buy medicines, be sure to tell the pharmacist clearly about the dosage you are taking as well as your allergy history. A photo of an old pill case in your phone will make the comparison much faster and more accurate. Don't take prescription medications on your own just because you heard someone tell you to. If your symptoms become severe, contact an emergency or seek medical attention immediately.
editorial.expectation_vs_reality: The red dot that says "nearest pharmacy" on the map is sometimes a closed store or doesn't have the medication you need. Pharmacists are very supportive, but they can't replace doctors in examining and diagnosing diseases. Especially if you're having trouble breathing, have an allergic reaction, have an injury or have severe pain, pharmacies aren't the right place to stop.
before_you_go: Keep the name of the medication you're taking and a list of your allergens.
Call the store to lock in opening hours and check if medication is available.
Absolutely do not share medications with others or arbitrarily increase the dosage.
If you have severe symptoms, you must seek emergency medical help immediately.
curiosity_questions: In the middle of the night in the North or South Island, how do you find a pharmacy that is still lit closest to you?

editorial.short_summary: The journey to find a place to see a doctor in Phu Quoc should start by asking yourself: do you just need a routine examination or are you in an emergency? Clinics are often located intertwined in crowded residential areas. However, if there are signs of worsening or having an accident, call an emergency immediately or go directly to the nearest medical facility that is capable of receiving you.
editorial.practical: For non-emergency minor illnesses, before going to the clinic or hospital, you should call in advance to ask about the hours, services, estimated costs, and necessary documents to bring. If you have travel insurance, keep a support hotline number and ask for the procedure for guaranteeing hospital fees. Don't forget to bring a list of medications you are taking and information about your body's allergies.
editorial.expectation_vs_reality: The directory can give you your address and phone number, but it doesn't guarantee that there is a doctor on duty or the right specialty you need at that time. In a critical situation, don't waste precious time reading reviews online or waiting for a confirmation message before leaving.
before_you_go: Immediately save the phone number of the medical facility and the travel insurance hotline to the computer.
Always carry identification, along with information about medications you are taking or a history of allergies.
If the illness is mild, call to get tested before you arrive.
Experiencing shortness of breath, heavy blood loss or unconsciousness, do not hesitate to call an emergency immediately.
curiosity_questions: In the darkness of the night, what sign tells you to run straight to the emergency department instead of a private clinic?

editorial.short_summary: Engrossed in wandering but "in need", an accurate map will be more valuable than a thousand descriptions. At attractions, restaurants or busy neighborhoods, look for signs or boldly ask the staff. Don't assume that every romantic beach has a public toilet available for you.
editorial.practical: If you need to deal with your sadness, open the "Near Me" feature on the map, aim for the nearest point and take a close look at the entrance and opening hours. If you are sitting at a café, restaurant, or amusement park, asking the staff directly is the fastest way. In particular, before embarking on a long journey away from the center, take advantage of the "solution" at major stops.
editorial.expectation_vs_reality: The toilet pin on the map does not promise that it is open, free to use, or open to visitors. Many places only prioritize this utility for customers using their services. Look at the map as a suggestion and be prepared to confirm it when you arrive.
before_you_go: Scan for the nearest toilet before leaving the high-service area.
Politely ask the staff if outsiders are allowed to use the restroom.
Pocket a pack of tissues and a mini bottle of hand sanitizer, and you'll find that they're a lifesaver.
Make the most of the clean toilets at the stop on long journeys.
curiosity_questions: While watching the sunset in Sunset Town, where can you find public toilets in the corners?

editorial.short_summary: Whether it's visiting the night market, visiting Sunset Town or any other hot spot by private car, looking at the parking lot in advance will help you escape the frustration of running around vertically. Car and motorbike parking spaces often differ from entrances, hours to fees, so aim for the right parking lot for your "war horse".
editorial.practical: When driving to the amusement park, look for a parking lot located neatly near the entrance and ask for the price and closing time. A small tip is to take a picture of the location of the parking lot or save the name of the nearby shop so that you can leave in the dark and know where to find it. If you are riding a rental car, be sure to check the overnight parking rules and how to lock the car safely that the rental company instructs.
editorial.expectation_vs_reality: Online parking lots sometimes quietly change gates, suspend or jam when you arrive. In large tourist areas, parking lots are often divided to serve each separate gate cluster. And please don't be lazy to walk a few steps and conveniently park your car blocking the gate of people's houses, blocking emergency exits or delivery roads.
before_you_go: Look carefully to see if the parking lot accepts cars or motorbikes before turning in.
Ask for the price and closing time of the parking lot.
Take a photo of the bus ticket or the view around the parking lot as a marker.
Park civilly, avoid blocking the passage of residents or the entrance and exit of rescue vehicles.
curiosity_questions: Riding a motorbike or driving a car down to Sunset Town, do you share a gate to the parking lot?

editorial.short_summary: Riding a motorbike around the North Island or walking late at night, the experience is to fill up the gas tank as soon as you are in the crowded central area. There are roads without gas stations or early rest stations, so don't risk letting the gas needle hit the bottom and then rush to find a place to dump.
editorial.practical: Before screwing the throttle for a long journey, glance at the gas tank to see if there is plenty of gas available and locate gas stations along the road. If you drive a rental car, be sure to ask the car owner what gas to fill with the right machine, and always ask for a rescue phone number in case the car is broken. At the station, remember to call the right type of gas, turn off the car carefully and pay attention to safety principles.
editorial.expectation_vs_reality: The red dot at the gas station on Google Maps may not have greeted you with bright lights when you arrive. Once you're out of town, it's much more important to target a gas station than to leave it to your fate to wait for the next station. Retail bottles of petrol sold at the grocery store are just a situational solution, not as safe and quality as a standard pumping station.
before_you_go: Fill up the tank in the CBD before conquering long routes.
Ready a convenient gas station for the time of returning.
Definitely the right type of gasoline for the car you are renting.
Absolutely do not puff on a cigarette or use the phone while standing next to the pump.
curiosity_questions: Being passionate about Rach Vem all day long, how do you calculate the gasoline for the way back?

editorial.short_summary: Suddenly thirsty, craving snacks or lacking personal belongings, convenience stores around your neighborhood are always a savior. The center of Duong Dong will be full of choices, but if you intend to go to small islands or to the north of the unspoiled island, it is best to gather enough tools in advance.
editorial.practical: Right in the area where you live, you just browse the map to find a minimart and then look at the opening hours; if you need something special, call in advance to make sure you eat. Before boarding the ship for a snorkeling tour or visiting the North Island, stop by the store to buy enough spring water and essential supplies as soon as you are in the busy area.
editorial.expectation_vs_reality: Not every minimart on the island is as bright as 24/7 or filled with goods like a large supermarket. The hours on the map are often slow to update, and small shop owners may close early for holidays. If you have something that needs to be purchased, always have a backup store in place.
before_you_go: Shop for all the necessities before rolling out of the center.
Check the closing times if you often go out late at night.
Keep the receipt in case you need to exchange and return the item.
Don't rush to believe the words "Open 24 hours" online if you haven't confirmed it with your own eyes.
curiosity_questions: If you forget to buy something and have to go to the pier in the morning, how can you find a grocery store that is both convenient and opens early?

editorial.short_summary: Sweating and craving a place to shower, change or send things, the "Near Me" utility is what everyone wants, but the current data warehouse has not verified enough accurate points. Don't draw your own list from a fuzzy memory or assume that "that beach definitely has it".

No one expects to have an accident, but if you miss an accident or fire, it is extremely important to calmly call the right number and accurately locate where you are standing. The 112 lnumber is a general rescue switchboard, but specialized numbers such as 113, 114, 115 are still the direct lifesavers you have to take to heart.
editorial.practical: When the phone is connected, the first sentence you say must be the current location or the nearest identification marker, then quickly describe the incident, the number of the victim and leave the contact phone number. While floating at sea and encountering an accident, try to read aloud the name of the ship, the name of the tour, the departure station and the current location. Remember to always hold the phone firmly to wait for people to guide you to the next step.
editorial.expectation_vs_reality: The 112 number will pick up and switch to 113, 114 or 115 depending on the situation. But remember, losing your luggage, changing your plane ticket or getting stuck in a schedule isn't an "emergency", call the airline or airport to deal with it. Calling the wrong place only delays people who really need to save their lives.
before_you_go: Immediately save the set of numbers 112, 113, 114, 115 to your contacts or standby screen.
Shoot the hotel locator for the roommate when he is lost and needs to call for help.
When I go to the sea to play, I have a hard time remembering the name of the canoe and the wharf I just stepped into.
Call the right place, report the right place and don't hang up in a hurry if the operator hasn't given permission.
curiosity_questions: In the midst of the thin line of trouble, when do you dial 112, and when should you dial 113, 114 or 115 directly?

editorial.short_summary: The Tien well is actually a small geyser of water leaking from a rock crevice in the Ong Doi Cape area, where local people for many generations have been passionately passing on anecdotes about Lord Nguyen Anh sticking his sword into the rock to find a source of fresh water. The underground geyser is a real landmark; but slashed sword marks or fantastical details, tinged with fairy tales, are pieces of the treasure of folk tales, and they should be introduced in the spirit of that dream.
editorial.practical: Located in the Mui Ong Doi area, access to Gieng Tien may be a bit of a barrier due to changes in the management of the surrounding resorts. If you wish to go to the city, you should check in advance which public trails are still allowed to circulate. Once you have arrived, admire and take photos in a gentle and delicate way; absolutely do not intentionally physically impact the natural water or damage the rocky landscape around the mouth of the well.
editorial.expectation_vs_reality: The people who cling to this land still keep the story of Lord Nguyen Anh looking for refreshments for the rebels and the sharp slash marks on the rock. It is a ribbon of legends tightly tied to the collective memory of the indigenous people, but absolutely not the details that have been confirmed by historians to confirm the archaeological evidence. You have the right to be fascinated by that historical story, but when telling it, be clear about the boundaries of which is a real geographical place and which are the clouds of folklore.
before_you_go: Carefully explore the route and verify the freedom of access to the destination on the same day.
There is a stark separation between a real physical location and the glittering embroidery details of the legend.
Conservation awareness: it is forbidden to engrave names, throw coins, throw garbage or scoop water without understanding the regulations on the protection of relics.
If you hear a different version, just ask the narrator where they copied the story from.
curiosity_questions: What mysterious bond has caused a small geyser in the South Island to be deeply rooted in the stories of Lord Nguyen Anh's escape?
The Fairy Well is a real creation of nature, so is the story of the sword slashing and cracking the rock a fragment of history or just a product of the soaring imagination of the legend?

editorial.short_summary: The majestic words at Dinh Cau, the vows for calm waves before each trip to sea have been tightly intertwined with the flesh and blood and spiritual life of many fisherman families in Duong Dong. Travelers can cross here to watch the river pour into the big sea or hunt for a brilliant sunset, but always remind yourself that under the shadow of these rocks is still a sacred place for people to light incense and practice sacred beliefs.
editorial.practical: If you happen to walk to Dinh Cau at the right time when people are sincerely performing the ceremony, automatically lower the volume of your voice and politely give them some space. Tourist information sources often whisper to each other about large religious activities that fall in the middle of the middle of the October lunar month; if you dream of immersing yourself in this atmosphere, be sure to check the local official announcements for that year for accuracy. A smile and a request for permission before putting the camera up to take a close-up of the person worshipping is always a civilized act.
editorial.expectation_vs_reality: Floating articles about Dinh Cau sometimes call names and assign completely different objects of worship. Faced with historical pieces that have not been fully reviewed by researchers, the most honest way to tell a story is to clearly state who told the story, rather than strongly presenting it as an indisputable scientific conclusion.
before_you_go: Choose discreet, courteous clothes and behave humbly in a sacred place.
Delicately observe, do not block the path of people who are holding incense bundles to offer the ceremony.
It is mandatory to show your teeth and ask for permission before you want to take pictures of the people or the area where the incense burners are placed.
Keep in mind that the day of major ceremonies and the time frame of religious activities can "dance" differently depending on the year.
curiosity_questions: What secret prayers do the fishermen who work hard to earn a living send when they bow down in front of the Palace?
What is the profound reason that has given birth to so many different variations when it comes to the identity of the god who reigns at the Palace?

editorial.short_summary: The children of the high seas throughout the Southern strip always call whales by a name tinged with reverence: Ca Ong. On Phu Quoc Pearl Island, that aura of deep faith and gratitude is still being kept alive through thrilling oral anecdotes, smoky incense mausoleums and occasions when the whole community gathers together for a big ceremony.
editorial.practical: Every time visiting the Ca Ong mausoleum or accidentally encountering a bustling holiday, visitors should only obediently stand and observe in the outer areas allowed by the organizers and remember to ask for advice before wanting to go deep into the altar. Be polite to give way to the procession, keep silence and keep your hands away, do not touch the sacred items. You must be aware that this is a sacred and flesh-and-blood religious activity of the local people, not an art show staged to entertain tourists.
editorial.expectation_vs_reality: Fishermen have countless different ways to convey their faith in the ocean, but to be clear, the belief in worshipping Ca Ong and the worship at Dinh Cau are not directed towards the same object, nor is it a form of ritual casting the same mold. The laziness of gathering everything together and calling it roughly by the name 'sea prayer ceremony' sounds neat, but it ruthlessly erases the unique and distinct cultural touches that each community is trying to preserve.
before_you_go: Take the initiative to ask the person who holds the responsibility of governing before you want to step inside the temple area.
Control your voice and politely nestle to give way when there is a group of people who are conducting the ritual of receiving spirits.
Immediately abandon the curiosity of touching objects of worship with your hands or self-acting to take close-up photos of others.
Take the trouble to browse the local government's announcements to know the exact schedule of the ceremony.
curiosity_questions: Coming from respect or is there a legend that seafarers revere whales as Ca Ong?
What are the differences and separations of the custom of worshipping Ca Ong compared to the rooted belief foundation in Dinh Cau?

editorial.short_summary: The Nghinh Ong festival is a red thread throughout the association with the belief in worshipping Ca Ong of communities clinging to the sea to make a living. The focus of the ceremony is the procession of spirits from the open sea to the mausoleum, accompanied by a series of ceremonial activities to send wishes for calm waves and calm seas; However, the time and scale of the decoration may have completely different nuances depending on the movement of each locality and each festival season each year.
editorial.practical: If you want to see the Nghinh Ong ceremony with your own eyes, you must regularly watch the local internal announcements, because from the date, time, venue to the size of the procession may "dance" differently from year to year. The trick is to arrive early to get a part of the most favorable observation angle, and remember not to stand there to obstruct the progress of the procession. If you want to grab a photo at close range, the minimum courtesy is to smile and ask for permission from the person in charge or the people who are attending first.
editorial.expectation_vs_reality: The Welcoming Ong ceremony is essentially a religious gathering and internal belief of a whole community, it does not follow the script of a commercial entertainment program with fixed opening and closing times pasted on the poster. The ceremonial stages can be completely cut or varied depending on the budget situation and actual circumstances of each year. Visitors can completely stand outside the and immerse themselves in that sacred atmosphere, there is no need to push and crowd their faces in the middle of the procession formation to feel the "soul" of the ceremony.
before_you_go: Immediately search for the official announcement of the local government in the year that you are about to land.
Wake up early, take a step ahead and always know your fate is nestled away from the main communion path.
Lock your mouth tightly, keep the volume at a whispered level, and resolutely do not repeatedly slam the flash into the area where the ritual is being celebrated.
A nod to ask for opinions before holding up the camera to capture the faces of those who are immersed in the ceremony is indispensable.
curiosity_questions: What is the source of spirituality that obliges the Nghinh Ong ceremony to have a procession of spirits stalking from the far sea to the mainland?
After successfully bringing the god of the sea to rest at the mausoleum, what other mysterious rituals do the people of the fishing village often continue to celebrate?
